changelog: Admin board: an "Owner" filter narrows the board to one or more owners' records — applied on the server (`?owners=` on `GET /api/mentorship`, ANDed with the caller's scope so it narrows but never widens), so counts and paging match; kept in the URL and in saved views. Each card shows its owner's initials beside the name (#3658).

en: Board: filter by owner to see one colleague's records, and see at a glance whose each card is.
tr: Pano: sorumluya göre filtreleyerek bir iş arkadaşının kayıtlarını görün; her kartın kime ait olduğu bir bakışta belli.
de: Board: Nach Zuständigen filtern, um die Datensätze einer Kollegin oder eines Kollegen zu sehen; jede Karte zeigt auf einen Blick, wem sie gehört.
